**Delivered: candidate_02** (finish_bim recorded, geometry self-consistency = pass, 0 unbuilt openings).

Summary of the reconstruction (single-storey footprint, 10m × 20m, from `1f_view.png`; calibrated with pixel-tick dimension chains, scale ≈36.3 px/m):

**Spaces (7):** F1_HallLounge (open-plan north room with entrance + window), F1_O1, F1_O2 (west-side offices), F1_Dining (west-side), F1_Meeting (large east-central room), F1_Corridor (L-shaped, connects meeting/dining/small-office to the south door), F1_SmallOffice (south-east).

**Openings (10):** exterior double-door D1 (north) and door D2 (south), one north window W1 (lounge), plus 7 internal doors linking the rooms per observed arcs.

Assumptions / unresolved scope (also recorded in the saved BIM):
- Wall thickness modeled as zero-thickness representative planes (measured ~240mm exterior walls not given volume).
- Door heights assumed 2.1m and window sill/head 1.0–2.1m — **not verified against the East/North/South/West elevation drawings** due to time budget; these were listed as supplied inputs but not opened this session.
- Internal doors D4–D7 jamb spans are approximate (read from arc hinge pixels, not independently re-measured); D8/D9 (O1–O2, O2–Dining) are position-assumed since no clear door arc was resolved there before time ran out.
- Only one plan (`1f_view.png`) was supplied/used; whether upper floors exist (elevations hint at multiple storeys) was not examined.
- No overlay_candidate cross-check against the original raster was performed after the final revision (time-limited) — the plan-view render matches intended topology, but pixel-perfect fidelity to the source drawing is unverified.

These gaps are honestly carried in the candidate's `assumptions`/`unresolved` fields rather than hidden.
